A large '''reptilian creature''' was hanging from the ceiling in [[Logray's hut]] on [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], and while it appeared to be unresponsive when an intruding [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] opened its mouth and peeked inside, a [[Unidentified purple snake-like Endorian creature|smaller reptile]] which had been hiding inside the creature stuck its head out of the larger beast’s mouth and angrily snarled at the Dulok.<ref name="1-02">{{Ewoks|The Haunted Village}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The creature strongly resembled a real-life alligator.<ref name="1-02" />
